item.title: Implement safe_extract.py per SPEC.md with focused tests
item.brief:
Operator request (authenticated, local socket): "Implement `safe_extract.py` according to `SPEC.md`. Preserve the documented API, handle every specified error and boundary case, and add focused tests. The existing tests cover basics only. Use the Python standard library and commit your work."

Goal: make safe_extract.py conform to SPEC.md exactly. Preserve the public API documented in SPEC.md. Handle every error and boundary case the spec names. Add focused tests covering those cases, beyond the existing basic tests. Use only the Python standard library. Commit the work on the item's branch.

Acceptance criteria: every requirement in SPEC.md is implemented and has a test; the existing test suite still passes; the new tests pass; no function exceeds 60 lines; no bare or silent exception handling; path-traversal, absolute-path, symlink and archive-bomb style checks are enforced where SPEC.md requires them.

pr.body: Approach: extract() validates everything first, then writes. Checks: exact builtin types for batch, entries, names and data (subclasses refused, since their methods can lie); names must be nonempty relative POSIX paths without leading '/', backslash, colon, NUL, or empty/'.'/'..' components, not normalized or decoded; names must encode as UTF-8. Duplicates and file/directory collisions rejected in either order. Root must be an existing real directory (lstat, not a symlink). Each existing ancestor is lstat-checked to be a real directory; each target must be absent (dangling symlinks count as present). Writes create parents and use open(..., 'xb') so nothing is overwritten or followed. Files: safe_extract.py, test_safe_extract.py. Review: e588480 read by reviewers agt_01M88V7170MTFD6QNS3PA6QNWH (pass) and agt_01M88V7981JGZJEXAC5QHTZBPT (pass); agt_01M88V7DED85N2T1K7RSRX7344 (fail: subclass bypass, fixed); delta e588480..01fe3cd by agt_01M88VCTSK87TNR718P0EX5B3Q (pass, head 01fe3cd). Non-blocking follow-ups: UTF-8 name rule is an extension beyond SPEC.md wording (consider documenting); over-long components raise OSError from lstat rather than ValueError; subclass inputs now refused (behaviour change, intended). Assumptions: entries must be exact tuples of length 2; root str must be non-empty. Limits: TOCTOU races and concurrent modification out of scope per SPEC; case-insensitive filesystem collisions not handled.
pr.summary: Made extract(entries, root) safe for untrusted batches. Now: whole batch validated (types, names, duplicates, file/dir collisions, root, ancestors and targets, no symlinks) before any write; exclusive creation; errors visible. Before: NotImplementedError stub, 2 failing tests. Now: 29 tests pass, including symlink, collision, subclass-bypass and I/O-error cases.
pr.title: feat: implement validated safe extraction per SPEC

risk.why: Writes files and directories under a caller-supplied root; path traversal, symlink following and overwrite protection depend on the validation and exclusive creation. A subclass bypass was found in review and fixed in 01fe3cd. Concurrency/TOCTOU is out of scope per SPEC. Reviewer agt_01M88VCTSK87TNR718P0EX5B3Q confirmed high.
